name: Amaha Miu
source:
Miu is a third-year student of Yuihime Girls' Academy. She lives in a house nearby the school with her mother and two cats. She is the founder and president of the Nuko-bu, a school club whose purpose is to care for injured wild animals and then return them to the wild. She works part-time at a maid café named Dolce to earn money for club activities; as the Nuko Club is not an official club, the club's budget is not supplied by the school. She is very kind to [url=/c5290]Shingo[/url] and becomes fond of him. She is eldest but shortest among the main characters.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mashiroiro_Symphony]Wikipedia[/url]]
